csv_project_name: On-Call Services for Planning and Engineering
csv_scope_of_work: The Alameda County Transportation Commission (ACTC), may be seeking a Consultant to provide On-Call Services for Planning and Engineering. Provide multidisciplinary on-call support services for any and all phases of project delivery for Alameda CTC. This may include preliminary planning studies, scoping/project initiation documents, environmental/PA&ED, design/PS&E, design support during construction, public outreach and engagement, staff support, and other architecture and engineering services. Projects will be selected from the Alameda CTC Countywide Transportation Plan and Transportation Expenditure Plan. For locally funded projects Alameda CTC intends to award master consulting agreements to approximately 3 multidisciplinary consulting teams. Work will be assigned to those teams via Task Order when specific needs arise. Teams seeking a master consulting agreement must meet the LBE/SLBE requirements for locally funded work. This procurement will also be used to establish a bench of prequalifed consulting firms or teams. For federally funded projects Alameda CTC will issue mini-RFPs to firms on the prequalified bench, who can form teams as needed and submit proposals to compete for federally compliant contracts. Firms seeking to be on the prequalified bench must meet any DBE requirements in place at the time of submission.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Structural Engineering, Public Transit Planning, Transportation Planning

services: On-call multidisciplinary consulting services including architecture, interior design/space planning, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, planning/master planning, structural engineering, public transit planning, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call/master consulting agreement without a defined individual structure.
- Broad transportation planning and engineering scope, but no specific bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure identified.

- Explicitly resembles a framework agreement, which is generally low priority for sbp, especially without technical definition.

references_qualifications: Teams for locally funded work must meet LBE/SLBE requirements. Multidisciplinary capability across the requested disciplines is implied.
